title: Mixed Event — Connect Hearts Message — Episode5 Connecting Hearts

meta.Event Outline: The second-years at Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy are assigned a work shadowing program. Interested in learning about making fun memories for visitors, Saki, Emu and Shiho choose to visit an event planning company.

rows.Line: The day of the event
Event Venue

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Phew... That should do it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Shiho! Emu!
I'm done setting up the stationery.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're also done setting up the tables.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
This event's gonna be so good☆
I've been so excited that I haven't been able to sit still for weeks!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Same!
Let's do everything we can to make this event a success!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's make it a really wonderhoy event!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, super wonderhoy!
C'mon Shiho, join us!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? No, I...
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: Hello, you three.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! Hello, Ms. Kizaki!

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: Thank you for agreeing to help set everything up. We'll be opening soon, so let's all do our best today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, we promise to do our very best.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: We promise!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Would you be interested in writing message cards for White Day?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Come make cards to attach to your gifts for White Day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If you just want to make a message card, that's also okay!

rows.Speaker: Male Guest
rows.Line:
Oh...
Did you say message cards...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Wait, this person seems interested...)
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Welcome!
Are you looking to make a message card?

rows.Speaker: Male Guest
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
I just bought a present for my wife, but I still need a card... Would you mind showing me what you have?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
These are the cards we have available.
There are thirty types in total, so please choose whichever one you like.

rows.Speaker: Male Guest
rows.Line: Wow, I didn't realize you had so many.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! We have many different types available because we want everyone to find the perfect card!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You can even decorate your card using these stickers and stamps. Please have a look if you like!

rows.Speaker: Male Guest
rows.Line:
Thank you.
In that case, do you have anything with animals? My wife just can't get enough of them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
She likes animals?
In that case, she might enjoy these stickers over here.

rows.Speaker: Male Guest
rows.Line:
I see...
Birds, rabbits, squirrels, cats... They're all very cute.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We also have a sample card which uses them. Feel free to take a look.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You can even use these speech bubble stickers. It's really cute when you make it look like the animals are talking.

rows.Speaker: Male Guest
rows.Line:
Oh, that's a great idea!
I know she'd love that.

rows.Speaker: Male Guest
rows.Line:
Then...
Would it be alright if I wrote her a card?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Male Guest
rows.Line: How does this look?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh wow...! So many different animals!
This is absolutely adorable☆

rows.Speaker: Male Guest
rows.Line:
Haha. Thank you.
It's been so long since I last wrote a message card...

rows.Speaker: Male Guest
rows.Line: It's nice, making a card with someone specific in mind. It makes it easier to put your feelings into it...

rows.Speaker: Male Guest
rows.Line: I can't wait to give this to my wife.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We hope she really enjoys it!
se_walk_men_003_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. He looked so happy!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, and it was nice to see just how much he liked the products we recommended.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Definitely♪ Alright, we gotta keep up the good work and help everyone send their thoughts!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: Nice work so far, you three. Do you happen to be free right now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, yes! How can we help you?

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: We're starting to see a drop in guests...

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: Would it be possible to have one of you three go out with these samples to advertise our event?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, yes! I can go do that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, are you sure? That sounds really hard...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll be fine♪ I used to do this all the time at Phoenix Wonderland. It's been a while, so I wanna give it a try☆

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: Thank you very much. Then, if you don't mind, I'll show you where we've been given permission to advertise.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Roger!
Wish me luck, Saki, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I promise to send over lots and lots of guests☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Good luck!
se_walk_women_003_1
se_walk_women_003_2

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, let's keep calling over all the guests we can here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right! Who seems interested...? Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (That girl... She's probably around our age, right? She's inspecting each product really closely...)
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Welcome!
Aren't these pens just the cutest?

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line:
Oh, yes...
They caught my eye since you don't see many pens in these colors.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: And you have a lot of cards laid out, too. Is this some sort of event?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, it's an event sponsored by a stationery maker called Saishi Kobo. We're currently promoting some of their new products by having guests make message cards for White Day.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds like fun...!
I actually really love these types of stationery.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In that case, would you like to make some cards? It'll be your chance to tell those you care about most just how much you appreciate them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: One of these cards alone would also be a really nice gift!

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line:
That's really tempting...
I know a girl who loves these kinds of sparkly stickers.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line:
Actually, I think I'll pass...
Even if I made one for her, I doubt she'd accept it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Did something happen between you two...?

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to say that last part. It's really nothing serious...

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: But this person and I are sort of in the middle of a fight right now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Umm... If it's alright, could you tell us more about this person?

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line:
Oh...
So, we're childhood friends...
Shopping Mall Premises

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hear ye, hear ye♪
Come make cute message cards at our fun event!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You can cram all your thoughts and feelings into your cards, and tell people just how much you care about them on White Day!

rows.Speaker: Shopper
rows.Line: Hey, can we stop by the arcade before we start looking at clothes?

rows.Speaker: Shopper
rows.Line: Mommy, I wanna go to the toy store!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...
Everyone's all focused on their shopping...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What do I need to do to get them excited and interested in our event...?
<Oh, Emu, is that a frown I see on your face?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You sounded so excited about your White Day event when we last spoke...>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hello! I dropped by to see how you were doing♪>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I'm advertising our event to get more people to come!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I'm having a lot of trouble right now...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<I see, so that's why.
But if that's the case...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Hehe. I have a wonderful idea!
What if you...?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, that sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Doesn't it?
So, let's start getting everything ready♪>
